audit.why: Early/mid favors Naafiri (57.15% WR, weak mana-hungry Sylas early); late flips to Sylas via Kingslayer sustain and Hijack. Page states this correctly in content layer.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer text repeatedly calls Naafiri's dive 'W' with a 'lock-on' — per the kit, W is the untargetable pack-empower and the lock-on dash at a champion is R (E is the short 450-range dash). breakdown.cooldowns has no numbers.
audit.why: Kit file is authority: W = untargetable + packmate spawn + MS/AD; R = dash at champion, recast shield. Sylas E (Abscond/Abduct) is 13s rank 1, W heal 12s early, Hijack 80/55/30.
audit.corrected: Dive references moved to R/E; real cooldowns inserted; W described as untargetability/pack surge.
Sylas E 13s rank 1, W 12s early, Hijack 80/55/30 added.
